en: The First Collection, The Chapter on the Antelope (Kuruṅgavagga)
2. The Dog Jātaka: “Those dogs who were raised in the royal palace, well-bred, endowed with beauty and strength;”
"We are not to be killed; we are not to be slain.
This is no executioner, but a slayer of the weak.
Thus ends the second Jātaka, the Dog Jātaka.
